message.content: {"reachable":false,"rationale":"All four parents of crownData:exfiltrate are unreachable. Blocking kerberoast:credentialAccess prevents jumpHost:lateralMovement and vpnSession:authenticate. Blocking configSecret:credentialAccess prevents rdpLogin:authenticate; blocking tokenCache:credentialAccess prevents dbLogin:authenticate and ssoLogin:authenticate. Together with blocked apiToken:authenticate, these cuts prevent secretsManager:privilegeEscalation, domainAdmin:privilegeEscalation, fileServer:lateralMovement, printServer:lateralMovement, serviceAccount:privilegeEscalation, and monitoringHost:lateralMovement. Without monitoringHost, hypervisor:privilegeEscalation also fails its AND condition. Consequently vaultRead:collection, dbReplica:collection, shareMount:collection, and mailArchive:collection are all unreachable."}
